This model enhances performance in natural language processing tasks while reducing carbon footprint, addressing sustainability concerns in AI development. Gemini 4 Carbon aims to set new industry standards for eco-friendly AI models.

articles.title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
articles.summary: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

articles.title: U.S. investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
articles.summary: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.

articles.title: Ex-Palantir execs launch Dream with $17M from a16z to build AI world models for construction
articles.summary: Dream is grounded in real physics and construction standards. Just as LLMs learn from text, Dream's world model is trained on more than 100 million square feet of building data gathered from permit archives across the United States.

articles.summary: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

articles.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
articles.summary: The announcement came alongside parent company Alphabet's third-quarter earnings report, which saw revenue grow 25% year over year to $127.6 billion.

articles.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
articles.summary: Microsoft said it made $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ending September 30. It underscores the still-enormous financial dependency of the partnership.
